summary: Frontend-only test of the new Expo SDK 57 HomeServe Admin mobile app at 390x844 viewport. Login flow works (admin-login-email/password/submit + inline admin-login-error 'Invalid email or password' on wrong pw; successful login redirects to /home). Dashboard renders every requested element: admin-name 'Ops Admin', all 4 KPIs (today-bookings 10 with 66.7% vs 6 trend chip, live-jobs 2 with assigned/pending breakdown, today-revenue ₹4,165.87 with commission ₹635.47, online-partners 4 of 5), fraud-alerts-widget with 8 alerts, trend-range segmented (daily/weekly) + line chart, donut category chart with 6 legend rows, three quick-* actions, admin-search-btn → /search, admin-notifications-btn → /alerts. Bottom tabs (tab-home/bookings/partners/more) all tappable. Bookings tab: 51 rows, all 4 bookings-tab-* chips present, bookings-search-input present, tapping a row opens booking-detail-sheet (RN Modal bottom sheet) with reassign-btn-* and admin-cancel-btn-* visible. Partners tab: partners-seg present with 2 kyc-expand-* cards. More tab: more-cities/pricing/finance/admin-language-toggle/admin-logout-btn all present. Language toggle: switches whole UI to Hindi (नमस्ते Ops Admin, KPI labels, alerts, tabs → होम/बुकिंग/पार्टनर/और) and back cleanly. Backend /api/auth/admin/login verified via curl (200 with JWT). ONE BLOCKING BUG: session does not survive a hard page reload / deep-link — opening /cities, /pricing, /finance, /alerts directly all render 'Failed to load → Not authenticated' (401) and /more redirects back to /login. All data screens therefore unreachable via browser refresh or shared URL; must be reached only via in-app Press/router.push after a fresh login in the same tab. This also broke the admin-logout-btn test (user already logged out after goto /more). AuthProvider exposes a `ready` flag suggesting intended persistence but it is not storing/restoring the JWT on web (likely AsyncStorage missing on web or token kept only in React state).

ui_bugs.issue: Admin JWT is not persisted across hard reloads on web. After login the app works, but opening any deep link (/cities, /pricing, /finance, /alerts, /search?..., /more) in a new tab or after refresh shows 'Not authenticated' 401 for every /api/admin/* call, and the (tabs) group redirects to /login. Likely cause: token stored in context state only, or AsyncStorage write/read not implemented for the web platform. Fix: persist session.token via AsyncStorage (works on web via localStorage) and rehydrate before Stack renders; keep the `ready` gate until rehydrate completes.

critical_code_review_comments: AuthProvider exposes `ready` which implies async storage rehydrate, but the deep-link 401s prove either the rehydrate is a no-op on web or token was never written. Verify both the write side (login success) and the read side (rehydrate) use the same key, and that web uses localStorage via AsyncStorage polyfill.

Admin login error swallows the backend message when non-401; errMsg(e) worked here but add network-error branch so a dropped request still shows a user-visible string.

The alerts.tsx, cities.tsx, pricing.tsx, finance.tsx, search.tsx files render skeletons / 'Not authenticated' error cards correctly — UI is fine, only the token is missing. (4) Fraud alerts actions (alert-action-*) were not triggered this run.
rca_of_issue: Hard reload → React tree re-mounts → AuthProvider starts with empty session → (tabs) _layout.tsx sees `!session` and redirects to /login (visible on /more). For /cities, /pricing, /finance, /alerts (not inside the (tabs) group), the screen itself mounts and immediately calls useApi('/admin/...'). Because api() reads the bearer from session (empty), the request goes out without the Authorization header and backend returns 401 — the ErrorBox 'Not authenticated / Retry' is the correct UI for that state. The real fix is persisting the JWT + rehydrating before any screen below the Stack renders.
